{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the number of unique patient_id values and total rows
print(f"Total rows: {len(data)}")
print(f"Unique patient_id: {data['patient_id'].nunique()}")
print(f"Duplicate patient_id count: {len(data) - data['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check how many have sample_seq > 1 (re-tested patients)
duplicated_patients = data[data['patient_id'].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f"Number of re-tested patients: {duplicated_patients['patient_id'].nunique()}")

# Check the distribution of sample_seq per patient
sample_seq_dist = data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].max().value_counts()
print("Max sample_seq per patient:")
print(sample_seq_dist)"}
